assessments.name: In-class Quiz
assessments.description:
In-class Quiz. 5-10 (one choice or multiple choices) questions; test during each workshop
(9 weeks for normal workshops).
Quizzes are conducted using the Respondus LockDown Browser.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task (EFT)
assessments.description: The EFT can be designed to test understanding of basic unit content or presumed knowledge.

assessments.name: Project Execution Group Assessment #1
assessments.description: Groups to amend, update and present planning documents for sign-off.

assessments.name: Project Execution Group Assessment #2
assessments.description: Groups review risks, respond to triggered project change & report actions.

assessments.name: Project Execution Group Assessment #3
assessments.description: Groups prepare and present Project Progress Report and Change request form

assessments.name: Reflection of lessonlab simulation
assessments.description: week 10 will apply a lessonlab simulation, after the simulation, students will reflect on their actions and think about project execution

assessments.name: Reflection of guest lecture
assessments.description: There will be a guest lecture. Students will submit a reflection report after the guest lecture.

assessments.name: Group Assessment #4
assessments.description:
Groups prepare and present project closure documentation.
Final group presentation (week 12 and 13) followed by a live Q&A session.
assessments.type: Q&A following presentation, submission or placement

assessments.name: Individual Assignment
assessments.description:
Post case simulation project review and lessons learned for future practice.
Personal report
